content.comment_body: Hello, I've started testing a [article_no] device. Connection through [product_name] software is working well, and my programs run as expected. I uploaded a test using [product_name], which succeeded and created a /webroot site. But when I enter the device's IP address in a browser, I only see a page labeled 'Open Source Software Declaration' and a link to a readme file. Am I missing a particular setting? I tried entering /webroot but received a 403 error. Current firmware version is [version_no].

Perhaps I wasn't clear. I'm not attempting to create a hyperlink; I'm trying to navigate to the homepage of the [product_name] device by entering its IP address in the browser. I'm attaching a screenshot from Chrome that shows what appears when I visit the device's IP.
Have you enabled LSC and [product_name] access in the access control settings? Also, confirm that web server access is allowed.
My apologies, I missed configuring that step. Thank you for your assistance.
Yes, thank you. I was on-site but managed to connect to the web server successfully today.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced an issue where, after uploading a test via [product_name], accessing the device's IP only showed an 'Open Source Software Declaration' page instead of the expected main interface. The issue stemmed from an overlooked configuration step in enabling web server related access controls. After clarifying and updating these settings, proper access to the device's homepage was achieved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated that after uploading a test with [product_name], entering the device's IP in a browser would display its homepage and main web interface.
